name: lvindex
description: lvindex: offline index and review cache for LabVIEW projects, as a Claude Code plugin (skill + hook)

plugins.name: lvindex
plugins.description: Skill that has Claude read a LabVIEW project through lvindex instead of whole AIXML exports, and a hook that stores every labview-mcp export in the project's lvindex cache. Needs the lvindex command: pipx install git+https://github.com/Bakurek/lvindex
